title: Lesson 1 Checkpoint — Possessive Adjectives

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Possessive Adjectives: Possessive adjectives replace articles before nouns: my book, her car. Match the owner: his = a man/boy, her = a woman/g

questions.question: Complete: This ___ my house.
questions.explanation: Possessive adjectives replace articles before nouns: my book, her car. Match the owner: his = a man/boy, her = a woman/girl, their = plural.
